items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mom’s name was Laura Hampton.

ctx.x: My mom’s name was Laura Hampton. So I’ve always loved the song Laura because of her, because she – it seems like they wrote that for her. She was such a wonderful person. Everything she did in her life was for other people. She never did

anything for herself. I just remember this wonderful feeling whenever I looked at her. She always just had this wonderful energy about her. She and my dad got along so well. They stayed married. Once they – his first wife – they stayed married for the rest of their lives.
